description: This file defines a Java class MessageOnlyLogFilter that implements the LogNode interface. The class acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing only message content downstream and suppressing metadata such as tags or priority levels. It provides constructors for setting the next LogNode in the chain and overrides the println method to filter log output.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class implementing LogNode to pass only message content in a chain of logging objects.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Overrides LogNode.println to pass only the message to the next node, ignoring other parameters.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
